# Camp Resource: Cookie Jar

Keep this Cookie Jar in your C.A.M.P. for those tough times when you really need a Cookie.

Generates Snacks

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Cookie Jar__

**Produces**

Blackberry Honey Crisp - AP Regen

Fancy Lads Snack Cakes - Pre-War Food

Mud Cookies - AP Refill

S'Mores - Max AP

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

1 Pound

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Vault-Boy Cookie Jar__ - 500 atoms

Atom Shop - __Modern Kitchen Bundle__ - 1800 atoms

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
